changed: Writing Tools and the Mac's text services work on words you select in the new app, as they did in the old one
A reply streaming into a thread no longer redraws the whole of the new app for every few words, so it stays quick while agents talk
In the new app, the sidebar's counts and dots pop in when they turn up, and a row's status words fade over as they change, as they did in the old app
The new app waits for ten quiet minutes of changes before it builds an update, rather than building every one
fixed: A file an agent pinned and opened for you in the new app could fail to open when Highlights was slow or failed to load once
